title: Search log
context: Analysts start by eyeballing raw searches.
task: Return query, search_date and clicked for every search.
answer: SELECT query, search_date, clicked FROM searches;

title: Zero-result searches
context: Searches that returned nothing are a quality signal.
task: Return search_id and query where results_count = 0.
answer: SELECT search_id, query FROM searches WHERE results_count = 0;

title: Mobile users in India
task: Return user_id and email for users with device 'mobile' and country 'India'.
answer: SELECT user_id, email FROM users WHERE device = 'mobile' AND country = 'India';

title: Active campaigns
task: Return advertiser and budget for campaigns with status 'active'.
answer: SELECT advertiser, budget FROM ad_campaigns WHERE status = 'active';

title: Shopping and Travel campaigns
task: Return advertiser and category for campaigns whose category is 'Shopping' or 'Travel'.
answer: SELECT advertiser, category FROM ad_campaigns WHERE category IN ('Shopping','Travel');

title: 'How to' searches
task: Return query for searches whose query starts with 'how to'.
answer: SELECT query FROM searches WHERE query LIKE 'how to%';

title: 'near me' searches
task: Return search_id and query where query contains 'near me' or 'nearest'.
answer: SELECT search_id, query FROM searches WHERE query LIKE '%near me%' OR query LIKE '%nearest%';

title: The top of the org
task: Return name and level for employees where manager_id IS NULL.
answer: SELECT name, level FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL;

title: Searches in March 2025
task: Return search_id and search_date for searches between '2025-03-01' and '2025-03-31'.
answer: SELECT search_id, search_date FROM searches WHERE search_date BETWEEN '2025-03-01' AND '2025-03-31';

title: Biggest budgets
task: Return advertiser and budget ordered by budget descending, then advertiser.
answer: SELECT advertiser, budget FROM ad_campaigns ORDER BY budget DESC, advertiser;

title: Highest-paid engineers
task: Return name, level and salary for the 5 highest-paid employees (ties by name).
answer: SELECT name, level, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC, name LIMIT 5;

title: Daily budget
context: Budget spread over the campaign's days.
task: Return advertiser and daily_budget (2 decimals) = budget / (days between start_date and end_date).
answer: SELECT advertiser, ROUND(budget / (julianday(end_date) - julianday(start_date)), 2) AS daily_budget FROM ad_campaigns;

title: Query length
task: Return query and word_count = number of words (spaces + 1).
answer: SELECT query, LENGTH(query) - LENGTH(REPLACE(query, ' ', '')) + 1 AS word_count FROM searches;

title: Search hour
task: Return search_id and hour (integer) from search_time 'HH:MM'.
answer: SELECT search_id, CAST(SUBSTR(search_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS hour FROM searches;

title: Uppercase advertisers
task: Return UPPER(advertiser) AS advertiser_upper for every campaign.
answer: SELECT UPPER(advertiser) AS advertiser_upper FROM ad_campaigns;

title: Searches per category
task: Return category and searches count.
answer: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM searches GROUP BY category;

title: Impressions per position
task: Return position and impressions count, ordered by position.
answer: SELECT position, COUNT(*) AS impressions FROM ad_impressions GROUP BY position ORDER BY position;

title: Distinct queries
task: Return distinct_queries = COUNT(DISTINCT query).
answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT query) AS distinct_queries FROM searches;

title: Total ad spend collected
task: Return ad_revenue = SUM(cost) over ad_impressions, 2 decimals.
answer: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS ad_revenue FROM ad_impressions;

title: Overall search CTR
context: Share of searches with a click.
task: Return ctr_pct = AVG(clicked) * 100, 1 decimal, from searches.
hint: AVG of a 0/1 column is a rate.
answer: SELECT ROUND(AVG(clicked) * 100, 1) AS ctr_pct FROM searches;

title: Average salary per level
task: Return level and avg_salary (integer via ROUND) grouped by level, ordered by level.
answer: SELECT level, ROUND(AVG(salary)) AS avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY level ORDER BY level;

title: Campaign date range
task: Return first_start = MIN(start_date) and last_end = MAX(end_date).
answer: SELECT MIN(start_date) AS first_start, MAX(end_date) AS last_end FROM ad_campaigns;

title: Users per device
task: Return device and users count.
answer: SELECT device, COUNT(*) AS users FROM users GROUP BY device;

title: Headcount per org
task: Return org and headcount.
answer: SELECT org, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM employees GROUP BY org;

title: Spend per campaign
context: How much each campaign has consumed.
task: Return campaign_id and spend = SUM(cost), 2 decimals.
answer: SELECT campaign_id, ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS spend FROM ad_impressions GROUP BY campaign_id;

title: CTR per position
context: Do higher slots get more clicks?
task: Return position and ctr_pct = AVG(clicked) * 100 (1 decimal), ordered by position.
answer: SELECT position, ROUND(AVG(clicked) * 100, 1) AS ctr_pct FROM ad_impressions GROUP BY position ORDER BY position;

title: Top 5 queries
task: Return query and searches count, top 5 by count desc (ties by query).
hint: GROUP BY query ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5.
answer: SELECT query, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM searches GROUP BY query ORDER BY searches DESC, query LIMIT 5;

title: Heavy searchers
task: Return user_id and searches count for users with > 12 searches.
answer: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM searches GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 12;

title: Impressions with advertiser
task: Return impression_id, advertiser and cost for every impression.
answer: SELECT i.impression_id, c.advertiser, i.cost FROM ad_impressions i JOIN ad_campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = i.campaign_id;

title: Searches by desktop users
task: Return search_id and query for searches by users whose device is 'desktop'.
answer: SELECT s.search_id, s.query FROM searches s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE u.device = 'desktop';

title: Clicks per advertiser
context: Which advertisers get the most clicks?
task: Return advertiser and clicks = SUM(clicked).
answer: SELECT c.advertiser, SUM(i.clicked) AS clicks FROM ad_impressions i JOIN ad_campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = i.campaign_id GROUP BY c.advertiser;

title: Searches per country
task: Return country and searches count, ordered by searches descending then country.
answer: SELECT u.country, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM searches s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id GROUP BY u.country ORDER BY searches DESC, u.country;

title: Result-size bucket
task: Return search_id and bucket: 'none' if results_count = 0, 'few' if < 100, else 'many'.
answer: SELECT search_id, CASE WHEN results_count = 0 THEN 'none' WHEN results_count < 100 THEN 'few' ELSE 'many' END AS bucket FROM searches;

title: Searches per month
task: Return month (YYYY-MM) and searches count ordered by month.
answer: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', search_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM searches GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
